name: Wonder Pets Enterprises Corporation
summary: Wonder Pets Enterprises Corporation, a Taiwanese firm established in 1999 and based in Taipei City, specializes in offering a comprehensive range of pet food and various animal care products. Its diverse services encompass essential daily pet supplies, professional grooming, aesthetic treatments for pets, and a dedicated e-commerce platform. The company operates under several prominent brands, including Pet Park, Kaiduo Pet, and Cat and Dog Captain, effectively serving the broader pet care market. Its products and services are readily available to customers through both online channels and traditional retail outlets.
